note: v13: free scroll. No chapter heights any more (v12: 100/170/160 vh); each chapter is as tall as its copy plus clamp(96px, 12vh, 160px) padding top and bottom. The left copy reveals once per [data-beat] element when it reaches 78 % of the viewport; the sticky stage on the right switches to a chapter's scene when its copy reaches 55 % and plays the scene's beats once, time-based (desktop.js). beats = what happens on the right, in order (documentation; data-beat="n" on the left still names the beat a copy element belongs to).
